question: Can relative-depth apertures plus an independently trained door-status or transparent-glass-door source retain real door-level portals while rejecting no-portal views and large doorless open mouths?

cohort.identity_authority: Frozen SCIL was correct on all 8/8 entities; identity was not passed into any portal source.
cohort.authority: Development-only source diagnosis; this cohort cannot promote a successor.

relative_depth_aperture.name: RDAT row-rank aperture
relative_depth_aperture.formula: Per-image q02-q98 normalized relative inverse depth; within-row far-depth rank at or below 0.25; raw 8-connectivity; retain components intersecting the lower image third; area Top-3.
relative_depth_aperture.ood_diagnosis: Tai Po station was scale-separable, but Cheung Chau market bays overlapped the positive width and frame-structure range.

aislab_door_status.model: yolov5m_161 trained on DeepDoors2 plus photorealistic Gibson

translab_availability.decision: NO_GO_EXACT_CHECKPOINT; no mirror substitution or retraining

trans4trans_semantic_plane.author_contract: Whole RGB image resized to 512 by 512, ImageNet normalization, one forward pass, per-pixel argmax, nearest resize to source dimensions.
trans4trans_semantic_plane.composition: Assign each raw 8-connected class-5 component to the frozen RDAT Top-3 component with maximum pixel overlap; discard zero-overlap assignments; preserve RDAT set semantics.

threshold_free_topological_cut.name: RDAT-Anchored Glass Door Cut
threshold_free_topological_cut.rule: Within each exact frozen RDAT aperture, class-5 must intersect the aperture and disconnect the original 4-connected path between its lowest occupied row and its minimum inverse-depth pixels.

attribution.positive_signal: RDAT and Trans4Trans are complementary: the first retained coarse portal geometry at 4/4 and the second aligned glass-door semantics to a truth-member RDAT proposal at 4/4.
attribution.remaining_failure: Neither two-dimensional source supplies reliable absence or separates all door leaves from doorless framed openings. The topological cut bought specificity by collapsing positive coverage from 4/4 to 1/4.
closed: AISLab two-class door-status detections on the consumed PB7 pixels
Trans4Trans class-5 maximum-overlap as a typed portal authority
attribution.forbidden_rescue: No confidence, area, component, class-union, crop, prompt, seed, connectivity, morphology, resolution, model, or threshold sweep on the consumed PB7 cohort.

next_step: Use a new RGB cohort with real camera intrinsics for one metric-depth 3D portal-plane closure experiment. Freeze the cohort and camera calibration before model output; require positive planarity/closure separation from both no-portal and large-open-mouth controls. If no admissible K-known cohort exists, record NOT_EVALUABLE_SOURCE instead of guessing intrinsics or tuning PB7.
claim_boundary: Development-only diagnosis on a consumed public-image cohort. RDAT and Trans4Trans remain coarse proposal and semantic-alignment evidence, not physical portal ownership, access, opening state, traversability, active-view causality, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety authority.
